children: Overview
France automation platform's H1 2026 revenue fell 2.0% organically, driven by Mail segment decline
Digital segment revenue grew 6.7% organically, Mail segment revenue declined 5.7% organically
Company agreed to sell UK Lockers network for €65 mln, launching sale process for remaining Lockers business
Outlook
Quadient confirms FY 2026 organic revenue change of -3% to +1%, excluding Lockers
Company sees FY 2026 EBITDA margin above 19% for Digital, above 24% for Mail
Quadient expects FY 2026 leverage ratio (excl. leasing) of 1.2x, assuming UK lockers sale completes
Result Drivers
DIGITAL MOMENTUM - Digital segment revenue grew 6.7% organically, driven by increased subscription-related sales and strong demand ahead of France's e-invoicing mandate
MAIL DECLINE - Mail segment revenue fell 5.7% organically, reflecting a shrinking installed base and softer hardware volumes in Europe
COST DISCIPLINE - Mail segment profitability remained resilient due to cost discipline, tariff refunds, and cross-selling of Digital solutions
